pairs: Et venit unus de septem angelis,
And one of the seven Angels,
those who hold the seven bowls,
I will show you the condemnation of the great harlot,
cum qua fornicati sunt reges terræ,
With her, the kings of the earth have fornicated.
et inebriati sunt qui inhabitant terram de vino prostitutionis ejus.
And those who inhabit the earth have been inebriated by the wine of her prostitution.”
Et abstulit me in spiritu in desertum.
And he carried me away in spirit to the desert.
Et vidi mulierem sedentem super bestiam coccineam,
And I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet beast,
And the woman was clothed all around with purple
habens poculum aureum in manu sua,
holding a golden cup in her hand,
and with the filth of her fornication.
Et in fronte ejus nomen scriptum:
And a name was written upon her forehead:
and the abominations of the earth.
Et vidi mulierem ebriam de sanguine sanctorum, et de sanguine martyrum Jesu.
And I saw that the woman was inebriated from the blood of the saints and from the blood of the martyrs of Jesus.
Et miratus sum cum vidissem illam admiratione magna.
And I was amazed, when I had seen her, with a great wonder.
And the Angel said to me:
I will tell you the mystery of the woman,
and of the beast that carries her,
quæ habet capita septem, et cornua decem.
which has seven heads and ten horns.
and is soon to ascend from the abyss.
And he goes forth unto destruction.
et mirabuntur inhabitantes terram (quorum non sunt scripta nomina in libro vitæ a constitutione mundi) videntes bestiam, quæ erat, et non est.
And the inhabitants upon the earth (those whose names have not been written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world) shall be amazed upon seeing the beast who was and is not.
Et hic est sensus, qui habet sapientiam.
And this is for one who understands, who has wisdom:
the seven heads are seven mountains,
and the other has not yet arrived.
he must remain for a brief time.
the same is also the eighth,
and he is of the seven,
and he goes forth unto destruction.
Et decem cornua, quæ vidisti, decem reges sunt: qui regnum nondum acceperunt, sed potestatem tamquam reges una hora accipient post bestiam.
And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings; these have not yet received a kingdom, but they shall receive authority, as if they were kings, for one hour, after the beast.
and they shall hand over their power
These shall fight against the Lamb,
and the Lamb shall conquer them.
quoniam Dominus dominorum est, et Rex regum,
For he is the Lord of lords and the King of kings.
et qui cum illo sunt, vocati,
And those who are with him are called,
Et decem cornua, quæ vidisti in bestia:
And the ten horns that you saw on the beast,
these shall hate the woman who fornicates,
et desolatam facient illam, et nudam,
and they shall make her desolate and naked,
et carnes ejus manducabunt, et ipsam igni concremabunt.
and they shall chew her flesh, and they shall burn her completely with fire.
Deus enim dedit in corda eorum ut faciant quod placitum est illi:
For God has granted to their hearts that they may do to her whatever is pleasing,
ut dent regnum suum bestiæ donec consummentur verba Dei.
so that they may give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God may be completed.
Et mulier, quam vidisti, est civitas magna,
And the woman that you saw is the great City,
quæ habet regnum super reges terræ.
which holds a kingdom above that of the kings of the earth.”
